description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git p4' tool, specifically testing relative directory change behavior, environment variable handling, and symlink resolution in the context of Perforce (P4) integration.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon needed for tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, running a provided shell command sequence.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git environment after tests.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Removes environment variables to ensure a clean test environment.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a git repository using the 'git p4' tool.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules cleanup commands to run after a test completes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Perforce add command to include files in depot.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit in the repository.
